name: Walmart Ads
shortInfo: Advertisers can optimize performance metrics for walmart ads.
brief: DataChannel’s Walmart Ads Connector enables streaming relevant Walmart Ads data into a user determined warehouse.
about: The Walmart Ads provides campaign management and optimization capabilities and flexibility of access to on-demand performance metrics for Advertisers.
availableData:
[Ad Groups](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart-ads/pipelines/ad-groups.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of the ad groups.

[Ad Items](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart-ads/pipelines/ad-items.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the list of all the products added to the campaign catalog.

[Campaigns](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart-ads/pipelines/campaigns.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of the campaigns.

[Keywords](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart-ads/pipelines/keywords.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a list of all the keywords that are part of a campaign.

[Snapshot Report](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/walmart-ads/pipelines/snapshot-report.html)  
This pipeline can be used to generate and retrieve file-based snapshots of all the performance reports by entity, for a given advertiser, asynchronously.
